about: The class guides (Noah: a guide book for each class that tracks progression, given when the class is chosen). Each class's book is its own chapters, then a live 'Your Progress' page (drawn by the Codex from src/Classes.cpp ProgressNow), then the shared chapters. Paragraphs keep <b> and <i>. tools/gen_esp.py writes the books (BOOK guide_<class>) and src/Codex.h. (Noah: simple but accurate - each class: who you are, your altar, getting stronger, perks, trial and wonder; then three short shared pages.)

chapters.title: The Summoner
paras: A conjurer of the College of Winterhold. Your summons fight for you - every kill they make is yours: Cursed Essence, progress and trials.

You start with Conjure Skeleton, Conjure Wolf, the Conjurer's Staff (its bolts mark an enemy: all your summons attack it until it dies or you mark another; hold it at an Echo Altar and take the Reforge row to make it stronger) and the summoner's robes.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Call a Summon - the first rung of a summon family you don't have. You carry two families at a time.
Bind a Hero - your Legendary pact: a hero of old (Ysgramor, Miraak, the Ebony Warrior...) or a great army. Opens at six freed altars.
The five families: the Dead (Skeleton to Death Overlord), Beasts (Wolf to Werebear), Daedra (Dremora to Warlock), Dwemer (Spider to Ballista Master) and the Wild (Spriggan to Earth Mother).

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: Kills fill it, the altar raises it. Kills with the spell in your hand count toward its next rung - 25, then 60, then 120 for the Legendary rung - once three Echo Altars are freed. Then hold it and take the altar's Reforge row: 5,000, 8,000, then 12,000 Cursed Essence, once a night per spell. The altar's Reforge row and Your Progress show the count.

Summon slots - how many summons you can have out at the same time. You start with 2, and get one more for every 2 Echo Altars you free, up to 7 (8 with the Conjurer's Command Mead). When every slot is full, a new summon replaces your oldest one.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Bonebinder's Brew - your summons have 50% more health and deal 50% more damage.
Soul-Tether Wine - each time one of your summons kills an enemy, you heal 5% of your maximum health.
Conjurer's Command Mead - one more summon slot (up to 8).
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Pact of the Host (your city trial): let your summons make the kills - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

Horn of the Spectral Wyrm (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. It calls a spectral dragon for a minute - until it falls once Alduin is slain.

chapters.title: The Battle-mage
paras: A battle-mage of the College of Winterhold: a different element in each hand, struck from afar - bolts, beams, storms and runes.
You start with Firebolt (right hand), Ice Spike (left hand), the Wild Witch's hat and gown and a Destruction tome.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Call a Spell - the first rung of an element you don't have. You carry two at a time.
Call a Support Spell - Ash Cloud, Cinder Storm, Charged Nova or Symmetry, yours to keep.
Six ladders, all cast from afar: Fire, Frost, Shock, Sun, Blood and Runes, four rungs each.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: Kills fill it, the altar raises it. Kills with the spell in your hand count toward its next rung - 25, then 60, then 120 for the Legendary rung - once three Echo Altars are freed. Then hold it and take the altar's Reforge row: 5,000, 8,000, then 12,000 Cursed Essence, once a night per spell. The altar's Reforge row and Your Progress show the count.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Ember Heart Ale - Destruction kills burst and hurt the dead nearby.
Arcanist's Focus Tea - Destruction spells cost 25% less magicka.
Mana-Siphon Draught - each Destruction kill gives back 6% magicka.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of the Elements (your city trial): kill with two or more elements - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

Tome of the Six Fires (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. One cast looses the top spell of all six elements around you.

chapters.title: The Ranger
paras: Sworn to the Dawnguard. Bows and crossbows - every arrow counts.
You start with an elemental bow, the Dawnguard Crossbow with 30 bolts and the Drifter Outfit.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Call a Bow or Crossbow - one roll: six times in ten an elemental bow, four times in ten a crossbow or offhand bow. You carry one elemental bow; a new one takes its place.
The bows: Emberstring (fire), Rimehorn (frost), Stormreach (shock), Skyhowl (wind), Dawnspire (sun), Thirstbow (blood). A full draw hits hardest.
Better crossbows come as cities are freed (Dwarven and Elven at one, Glass and Ebony at two, Daedric and Dragonbone at three). Q / R3 at the altar fills your quivers.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: Kills fill it, the altar raises it. Kills with a bow count toward its next tier - 25, 60, then 120 - once three Echo Altars are freed. Then hold it and take the altar's Reforge row: 5,000, 8,000, 12,000 Cursed Essence, once a night.
Each tier: more damage, a new attack and a bigger quiver - 60, 100, 150, 200 arrows - that regrows one arrow every 8, 6, 4, then 2 seconds.
Crossbows: kills unlock elemental bolts - fire at 25, ice at 60, shock at 120.

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Fletcher's Sap Draught - your arrows or bolts slowly grow back.
Eagle-Eye Draught - bows draw and crossbows reload 25% faster.
Dawnwatch Tonic - with a bow or crossbow out, the dead hurt you 25% less.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of the Long Shot (your city trial): bow or crossbow kills from 30 m or more - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

The Subsuming Vortex (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. Its arrows open black holes that drag the dead in, then burst - wider and stronger once Alduin is slain.

chapters.title: The Spellsword
paras: A Vigilant of Stendarr: steel in one hand, a close-range spell in the other - a touch, or a spray of flame, frost, lightning, poison or blood.
You start with the Steel Spellsword, a Steel Spellshield, Flame Touch (left hand) and the Practical Pirate outfit.

chapters.title: Your Altar
paras: Call a Spell - the first rung of a close-range spell you don't have: the touches (Fire, Frost, Shock, Sun, Blood, Poison) or the breaths (Flame, Frost, Storm, Poison, Blood sprays). You carry two at a time.
Call a Spell-Weapon - a spellsword, greatsword or spellshield (sometimes a Mysticism shell or cloak). Better steel comes as cities are freed.

chapters.title: Getting Stronger
paras: Kills fill it, the altar raises it. Melee kills with the spell in your other hand count toward its next rung - 25, then 60 (a power-attack kill counts twice) - once three Echo Altars are freed. Then take the altar's Reforge row: 5,000 then 8,000 Cursed Essence, once a night.
Each reforge also raises your held spell-weapon a material and unlocks one of four Enchantment Powers (in your Powers).

chapters.title: Your Perks
paras: Bladesong Mead - each melee hit heals you 2%.
Spellbinder's Draught - melee kills give back 10% magicka.
Steel-Wind Ale - melee swings 20% faster.
One of each perk a life - death takes them all.

chapters.title: Your Trial and Wonder
paras: Trial of Steel (your city trial): melee kills with a spell in your other hand - 10 on Novice up to 30 on Legendary.

Dragon Slayer (your wonder): it can't be rolled or bought. Once six cities are freed, your path's secret wakes - a long hidden quest played from altar to altar, never twice in a row in the same city. Listen to the freed altars' whispers. Its last step hands you the wonder. Every hit carries your off-hand spell; once Alduin is slain, power attacks send it down the line.

shared.title: How a Night Works
paras: Day (about 20 minutes): the dead sleep. Explore, rest and spend your Cursed Essence.

Night: the dead claw up out of the ground (on open ground, never in houses) in waves - fast runners, more and tougher each night, coming from every side. Elites and bosses step out of the Curse's portals. Dawn only comes when the last wave falls.

The night's dead come in four kinds: the Risen Dead sprint at you and claw fast - hurt one past half and it turns frenzied; the Shambling Maiden is slower but tougher, and her blows come slow; the Grave Witch keeps back, hurls fire and calls more Risen Dead out of the ground - kill her first; the Volatile, a bladed brute, is slow but hits hardest and shrugs off half of every blow unless you hit its head or its back, and it leaps at you from a distance.

Noise brings worse: spells bursting, shouts and sprinting fill the Noise bar under the wave count; let it fill and an elite Volatile comes through a portal for you - far faster, and it pounces. Go quiet and it drains.
Cursed Essence drops from every kill - spend it at the Echo Altars. Watch for tokens: skull (Insta-Kill), coin (Double Points), falling star (destroys tonight's corpses), chest (Fire Sale).
Your health, magicka and stamina sit on one plate at the bottom; its rim glows blue while your shout recovers.

shared.title: The Echo Altar
paras: Every city has one. Step onto it and activate it. Move with the D-pad or W/S, choose with A or Enter, leave with B.
From the top: your class (change it for 2,500 Cursed Essence - each class keeps its own progress), your rolls, Reforge (after three freed altars), perks, then the city's trials.
After a roll, activate the altar again: take it (it replaces what it would), roll again at the next price, or leave it for half the roll back.

Freeing a city: finish four trials (three shared, one your class's), then slay its Dragon Priest, who rises at night. A freed city is a sanctuary, teaches you its Thu'um, and Whiterun gives you a dragon to ride.

shared.title: Settings
paras: Difficulty is Skyrim's own (Settings, Gameplay). From Novice to Legendary the dead have 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x, 1.6x, 2.2x, 3x health and hit 0.5x to 2x as hard. Until three altars are freed, on Adept or harder, no single hit takes more than 60% of a zombie's health.
Skyrim's own enemies get tougher with the difficulty and with every altar you free, so they keep up with you.
The Mod Configuration Menu page The Curse of Alduin has the rest: attack and draw speed, field of view, brightness, effects and controls.
